sn24.96:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe || ||
sn24.96:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || ||
sn24.96:3.1: Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || pe || || vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Vedanā || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || pe || vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassitum Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || || No etam bhante || ||
sn24.96:4.1: Tasmātiha bhikkhave yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā pahīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbam || Yā kāci vedanā || Yā kāci saññā || Ye keci saṅkhārā || Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītanāgatapaccuppannaṃ || pe || sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || ||
sn24.96:5.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati vedanāya nibbindati saññāya nibbindati saṅkhāresu nibbindati viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vumuttasmi vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karanīyam nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmīti || || Purimagamanaṃ
sn24.96:6.0: aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇā [ni] || Dutiyagamanaṃ chabbīsaṃ vitthāretabbāni || Tatiyagamanaṃ chabbīsaṃ vitthāretabbāni || Catutthagamanaṃ chabbīsaṃ vitthāretabbāni || || Diṭṭhi-saṃyuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ
